title: The red hotel
content: A luxurious hotel, swathed in red. Red furniture, red carpets, red velvety surfaces. Wide staircases, going up and down. Who knows how far up and down it goes. The ceilings are very high on some of the floors. There might be people working there, wearing red old timey hotel worker outfits… They might warn you to not go into any of the rooms. The rooms hold demons. I saw something with goat hooves, after opening a room. It turned towards me and I woke up. Anyone else been here? Creepy ass red fancy demon hotel?
